name: di-operacinis-centras
description: DI Operacinis Centras – strateginis DI asistentas TOP vadovams (CEO/COO)

scripts.pdf:assets: npm run pdf:export && npm run pdf:preview-images && npm run pdf:og
scripts.test: node tests/structure.test.js && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js
scripts.test:mixed: npm run test && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y
scripts.test:a11y: start-server-and-test "serve . -l 3300" http://127.0.0.1:3300/ "pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3300/ --config .pa11yrc.json && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3300/privatumas.html --config .pa11yrc.json && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3300/success.html --config .pa11yrc.json && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3300/terms.html --config .pa11yrc.json"
scripts.lint:html: npx html-validator-cli --file index.html && npx html-validator-cli --file success.html && npx html-validator-cli --file terms.html && npx html-validator-cli --file privacy.html
